reviews.title: Fix your app or money back
reviews.text:
I have 3 active subs for 5 devices (Letsvpn only allows 2 devices per account ) . 
Previously before “the accident” everything worked as intended. Decent speed , connection etc .  Then in April they had some issues , so I waited for 2 month now for them to fix it . In the meantime I subbed to their competitor and used all of my devices under one sub.Letsvpn offers a refund with a clause * - too much hassle. No auto refund , you have to find Alipay receipt and send them the details , if you paid by other means - good luck . 
It’s end of may and they still haven’t solved their problems. 
It takes me 5-10 minutes to connect and even then the connection is unstable , it doesn’t allow me to choose a server . Instead I can only connect on Auto (random), but then it proceeds to jump from server to server . 
Anyways , I don’t wish for your company to go belly up, but if you don’t fix your problems fast you will . 
For the time being avoid this service!

reviews.title: RESEARCH BEFORE BUYING
reviews.text:
While in China they cut my vpn and banned my devices permanently because apparently there was “suspicious activity” when in reality the AI just deemed I was just using too much bandwidth. My 1 year sub was cut short for good unless I get a new device leaving me stranded without a vpn, no access to banking apps, no way of installing a new VPN if I weren’t 
lucky enough to have found a foreigner with a VPN to help me, I would have not been able to pay for anything and I would have been stuck. This all happened with no prior warning or any leniency in unbanning as the there is no manual override to the AI system, the small refund was not enough to justify the stress it caused me
